posts.search: How Would You Design a Product for Users With Limited Access? Day 1 of 1,000 Product Manager Interview Questions Product Management 1000-product-management-interview-questions Product Discovery Imagine you're asked to redesign a navigation app for someone who doesn't have reliable internet access. What Is the Interviewer Actually Evaluating? 1. First, Define What Limited Access Actually Means 2. Choose a Specific User Segment Instead of Designing for Everyone 3. Understand Current User Behavior Before Designing Anything 4. Compare Your Options Before Choosing a Solution 5. What Would the Minimum Viable Product Look Like? 6. How Would We Measure Success? 7. What If You Only Had Two Weeks? 8. What Evidence Would Make You Reject Your Proposed Solution? 9. How Would I Answer This in a Real Interview? 10. What Makes an Interview Answer Weak?
